# ghost/camera

AOSP Camera: take a photo (back or front lens, optional countdown), take a selfie, record a short video, report the newest capture.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/camera
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/camera take_photo --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/camera take_selfie --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/camera record_video --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/camera last_capture --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `take_photo`: Take a photo
- `take_selfie`: Take a selfie
- `record_video`: Record a 5 second video
- `last_capture`: Where is the last photo I took?
